preview_text: “There was just one little cloud on the horizon. The night before I left Bangkok, Nunie did a divination using the old Chinese book of hexagrams called the I Ching. When I asked how my Bangkok life would go, we got the hexagram The Abysmal. ‘In the abyss one falls into a pit,’ the I Ching said. ‘Misfortune.’ And sure enough, on arrival at immigration in Osaka, I made the mistake of marking on my health card that I’d had a bit of diarrhoea.
